verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit documents a direct Claude Code integration in which Claude Code triggers CodeRabbit reviews and fixes the issues found. It also claims its IDE/CLI reviews "integrate seamlessly with your AI coding agents" and offers in-editor review in Cursor, so the core handoff to an agent is first-party. The evidence does not cover the rest of the story, so coverage is partial and the verdict cannot be full. missing for 10: copyable per-finding fix prompts, documented Codex integration, a documented handoff of review findings into Cursor's agent (only in-IDE review is shown), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the agent handoff.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, review findings hand off cleanly to my coding agent — copyable fix prompts or direct integration with Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex

citations.quote: Claude Code can trigger CodeRabbit reviews directly through simple commands, enabling you to build features, run code reviews, and fix issues without manual intervention.
Review uncommitted changes as you code, apply fixes instantly, integrate seamlessly with your AI coding agents, or run reviews in CI/CD pipelines.
Get instant feedback in VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf, and any VS Code-based IDE.
